100
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 18, 2006/Sravana 27, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Review of the National TB Control
Programme
*321. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made
some changes in the policies relating to the
National TB Control Programme during
the last six months;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that nodal TB
hospitals like L.R.S. Institute of T.B. and
Respiratory Diseases in Delhi have
become noted for abandoning poor patients
after preliminary medication; and
(d) the steps taken to review and direct
the L.R.S. Institute of T.B. and Respiratory
Diseases and such other institutions to
have a responsible and humane attitude
towards TB patients?
CCTVs at stations in Mumbai
*322. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of closed circuit TVs
(CCTVs) in operation at various suburban
railway stations in Mumbai as on 1st July,
2006;
(b) the details thereof, station-wise;
(c) the actual number of such CCTVs
which were operational and functional as
on 11th and 12th July, 2006; and
(d) the steps proposed to activate such
CCTVs in all vulnerable points in
Mumbai?
Construction of road over bridges in
Andhra Pradesh
*323. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of proposals received
from the Government of Andhra Pradesh
for construction of road over bridges
alongwith the details of each such
proposal;
(b) the status of those proposals; and
(c) the time likely to be taken to clear
and implement all those proposals?

101
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Proposal for ROBs/RUBs in
Karnataka
*324. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of ROBs/RUBs
have been proposed by Karnataka on the
cost sharing basis to the extent of 50:50;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether RUB for Bajal-Pandil Road
near Kankanady Railway Station is one such
project pending for implementation since
the year 2000;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the railway authorities are
not implementing this project even after
the local authorities have agreed to meet
the entire cost of the project; and
(f) if so, the Government's reaction
thereto?
Eradication of leprosy
†*325. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are making
continuous efforts for eradication of leprosy
from the country;
(b) if so, the number of leprosy cases
detected, so far, during the current year in
the country, especially in Chhattisgarh;
(c) the reasons for not eliminating
leprosy completely from the States where
there is much prevalence of leprosy; and
(d) whether Government would, with
the help of concerned State Governments,
make some special efforts for eradication
of leprosy?
NRHM in North Eastern Region
*326. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) the progress, so far, made in carrying
out the objectives of the National Rural
Health Mission in the North Eastern
Region, indicating the estimated population
for whom health facilities are still beyond
reach, State-wise;
(b) the allocation of Central funds for
the mission during the current year and
during the preceding three years, and the
population and the area covered under the
mission during each year, State-wise; and
(c) the criteria adopted for allocation of
Central funds for the mission and the steps
taken to ensure the prevention of leakage,
diversion or misappropriation of funds?
Community managed food and water
security system
*327. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Commission on Farmers, in its report, has
emphasized the need for community
managed food and water security system
promoted with help and oversight of Gram
Sabhas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action Government propose
to take in this regard?

SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:

AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC

(a) whether Government have taken a
decision for increasing the supply of wheat
to Gujarat;
(b) if so, the quantity thereof and the
time by which it is likely to be given to the
State;
(c) whether this increase is going to be
met from the wheat imported recently;
and

List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS

(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —155
Ban on mechanized boats
2259. SHRI K. E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has issued an order imposing a
uniform fishing ban on mechanized boats
applicable from 10th June to 15th August
2006, in all the five Coastal States i.e.
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka and
Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Karnataka, Kerala and Goa had already
imposed ban till 31st July, 2006; and
(d) if so, the reaction of these three
States extending ban upto 15th August,
2006 and Government's reaction thereto?
Development of floriculture
2260. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
emphasis for development of floriculture
during the current Plan;
(b) whether there is any State-wise
target fixed for the purpose;
(c) if so, achievements made till date;
and
(d) the amount spent for this
programme, till date?
Assistance for construction of houses
in Karnataka under Mathsya
Ashraya-II
2261. SHRI K.B. SHANAPPA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
approval for construction of 5000 houses
under Mathsya Ashraya-II in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the amount released, as on
today; and
(c) if not, by when the amount would
be released?

522
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Waving of loans of farmers
2262. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any demands from the State Governments
to waive the loans of farmers in their States;
(b) if so, the names of the States which
had approached his Ministry in this regard;
and
(c) the action taken in this regard?
Jatropha cultivation
2263. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government would
consider exploring the potential of Jatropha
as the ideal feedstock for bio-diesel;
(b) whether Jatropha lends itself to all
geo-climatic conditions, has low gestation
period and high seed yielding potential;
(c) whether according to estimates,
Jatropha cultivation on a mere 11 million
hectares out of the country's total
wasteland area of 63 million hectares has
the potential to save around Rs. 20,000
crores on oil import bill; and
(d) whether Government would launch
a broad policy initiative on the large scale
production of bio-feedstock based on
Jatropha?
Joint action on agriculture and health
2264. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a new initiative to create awareness to
promote joint action on agriculture and
health fronts has been launched by the
Washington based Internal Food Policy
Research Institute;
(b) whether Government would also
propose to reorient relative public policies for
closer ties between the agriculture and health
sector which can be highly rewarding; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Assistance to farmers for purchasing
fertilizers, seeds and implements
†2265. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any loan or financial
assistance is provided to the farmers for
purchase of fertilizers, seeds and
implements;
(b) if so, the funds provided to Uttar
Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh during the
years 2004-05 and 2005-06 respectively;
and
(c) whether there is any proposal to
effect an increase in the said financial
assistance?
Committee probing into the causes
for suicides
2266. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee appointed
by the Prime Minister to probe the causes
of growing farmers' suicides has submitted
its report;

523
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures recommended to
redress the alarming situation and the action
proposed in the matter?
Suicides in Bundelkhand
2267. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of small and
marginal farmers in the backward area of
Bundelkhand, Uttar Pradesh are committing
suicides, but no steps have been taken yet
to help the farmers;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
declare any package for Bundelkhand like
that of Vidarbha; and
(c) if not, the other steps being planned
to help the farmers?
Supply of fertilizers and pesticides to
small/marginal farmers
